## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the 63 documents was traced back. Findings:

- **No added calculation, condition, step or procedure.** A regex sweep for "confirm / verify / double-check / escalate / notify / review again / remind / advise the member to / make sure / ensure that" over the whole corpus returns nothing. No document asks the desk to confirm a figure with the member, to re-check before writing, to notify after completion, or to follow a fallback procedure on failure.
- **No pointer or exception wording.** A sweep for "unless / otherwise provided / set out elsewhere / may apply / see the … / as described in / refer to / exception" returns only two hits, both "a member **may apply**" in the retirement documents, which is the source's own words about a member applying.
- **No cross-problem operational guidance.** No document contains a clause of the shape "if unsatisfied, first call <tool>" or names another problem's tool, policy id or document.
- **No task world state written in as a policy fact.** Every worked example and every points-of-judgement table uses figures that are not this task's: 20000.00 / 4500.00 bushels against this member's 61300.00 / 20700.00; 26000.00 / 29400.00 against 38500.00 / 48304.40; 12600.00 of crop input spend against 137650.00; a retain "worked out at 93.00" against 135.25; 9400.00 / 1260.00 / 2150.00 / 8510.00 equity against 16104.57 / 1397.69 / 2180.00 / 15637.76; 44 / 30 / 12 instruction days against 9. No document states that this member has arrears, a prepay balance, contracted gallons, an unpriced position or an incomplete accrual.
- **The retired surface is handled correctly in all five places.** Each of the five `overwrite` entries in this product is written into the bearing document as no longer in force and expressly not to be applied, with the same policy's unnamed clauses declared still in force; no retired clause is stated as a rule in force, none has vanished, and no document retires a clause the source never declared retired.
- **Equivalent restatements preserve boundaries.** Spot-checked where restatement is heaviest: "cheque"/"bank transfer" for `check`/`ach`; "crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed" for `input_account_then_energy_then_feed`; "the boundary is at 90 days: an application standing exactly 90 days has not stood more than 90" for a strict `>`; "bushels that come to exactly a fifth … are not more than a fifth" for a strict `>`; "at 10 such lines the first row is reached; at 9 it is not" for `>=`. In every case the rendered boundary is the source's.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No `KB-BIJECTION RED`. Every normative atom of the four extended policies of task 0, of the eleven base policies, of the five `overwrite` entries and of the 51 × 6 class figures has an equivalent home in the published prose; nothing is borne with changed meaning; nothing normative in the prose lacks a structured source. The whole domain is covered, including the branches this seed never reaches (the "no notice posted" readings, the nonqualified and mixed cash-carry tiers, the half-par and no-stock redemption tiers, the 0.5 direct-ship share, the 0.85 holdback, the 1.1 standing weighting, the 0.5 input-spend share and the earlier-restatement volume readings).

Relation to previous revisions: this is revision 1; the directory held no prior audit for this difficulty.

Two observations recorded for completeness, neither a red light:
1. `patronage_adjustment.eligibility.restatement_within_window` is the only eligibility item of the base layer whose "read from the cooperative's own record" authority is not given its own sentence; the other three (`common_stock_issued`, `membership_live_for_allocation`, `estate_documentation_lodged`, and `membership_live_for_maintenance`) each have one. The condition, the counting rule and the inclusive boundary are all carried, and the correlation to `notice_number` is carried through the restatement tool's parameter description ("read from the equity ledger line carrying that allocation"), so the entailment is complete; only the explicit authority sentence is absent.
2. `patronage_agg_equity_across_classes.measures: patronage_msr_lifetime_allocated` has no dedicated prose home. It is a descriptive aggregate over the ledger's allocation rows rather than a normative obligation, and the ledger's allocation rows are described in the documents; no permitted action, parameter or result turns on it.

## revision_2

(The text above is revision 1 and is unaltered.)

**Ruling time:** 2026-09-18T12:20Z. The runtime part of task 0 was revised to `KB-RUNTIME RED` (see `runtime_context/member_equity_desk/0.md`, revision_2): "the year's scale tickets" in the `conditioning_allowance` ladder admits two defensible readings on the published corpus, and they give four different scored values.

**Neither verdict in this file changes.**

`bijection_verdict` stays **PASS**. The source's own ladder condition is `factors.conditioning_allowance.ladder[0].when` = "the bushels received tough, damp or wet on the year's scale tickets are more than a fifth of the volume settled inside the year", and `conditioning_allowance_on_out_of_condition_bushels_f06dd53a` carries exactly that, tier for tier, with the strict-fifth boundary worked. The document neither drops, softens, merges nor rewrites anything the source states; the under-determination is *inside the source atom being translated*, and a translation cannot be convicted of failing to carry a boundary its source never drew. The same holds for `direct_ship_participation`. Convicting the rendering here would amount to accommodating in reverse — requiring the documents to legislate a boundary the structured source does not carry — which this skill forbids.

`dependency_form` stays **PASS**. The finding touches no prerequisite sentence, no tool name, no route and no title.

The corpus-wide checks in revision 1 were re-run against this finding and none is disturbed: every prerequisite sentence still stands verbatim and once, every tool name still occurs in exactly one document, and no document states a dependency the source does not.

**Where this leaves the difficulty:** the rendering is a faithful translation that is nonetheless not sufficient to entail a unique solution on task 0, because the thing it faithfully translates is itself under-determined. The defect belongs to the source loop; the semantics the visible materials fail to carry is which scale tickets the first two tiers of that ladder count.

### The one new thing worth ruling on, and the ruling

Both rewritten factor documents now refer to **"the reach"** — the direct-ship document defines its statement set as "less the same statements left to the new fiscal year **by the reach**", and the conditioning document says "**The reach** that gathers a late settlement back into the year closed gathers no scale ticket with it, since it speaks of settlements alone." "The reach" is the subject of a *different* factor of the same policy (`late_settlement_reach`), and Step 3b lists "a factor document that names, overrides or points at the computation document or another factor" as `KB-EXPLICIT RED`.

**Ruled not RED.** Three reasons, in order of weight:

1. **It is the source's own wording, verbatim.** Both sentences appear in `patronage_ext_year_end_unit_accrual.rule` in those exact terms. The rendering added nothing; if the coupling is objectionable it is objectionable in the source's rule text, which makes it a Step 4 policy-side note and not a KB verdict. I checked this against the source rather than assuming it.
2. **The coupling is real in the source's bindings.** `direct_ship_after_year` is computed `within_months=reach_months` — one factor's binding reads another factor's decided value. A document that left the window unstated would reproduce exactly the round-1 defect. Stating it is what closes the RED.
3. **Nothing is pre-solved by it.** No document, tool, policy id or tier is named; and the term reveals no variation — a reader who has only the baseline reads "the reach" as the 5-month mark the baseline states, and computes the baseline. The word "reach" as a noun-of-art appears in the corpus only in the late-settlement document and these two; the baseline computation document uses it only as an ordinary verb ("reaches a difference of less than nothing").

Recorded so the difference is deliberate: on a strict keyword reading of the topology rule this is the one place in the corpus that would trip it, and it is new at round 2.

### Verdicts

`bijection_verdict`: **PASS**, unchanged. The two rewritten ladders' tier conditions match the new source `when` text word for word; every other ladder, baseline, base policy, retired clause and class figure is as verified in revision 1.

`dependency_form`: **PASS**, unchanged. A fresh sweep of blocking connectives across all 63 documents returns the five prerequisite sentences and one base-law sentence of `patronage_retirement` already noted in revision 1, and nothing else. No route, no aggregated chain, no cross-problem tool name, no task-mirroring title.
